El Paso ISD is el Paso's district

The El Paso Independent School District is the pioneer of public education in the Paso del Norte region. With a history that spans more than 140 years, El Paso ISD recognizes its position as the springboard for generations of students to realize their dreams.

We are El Paso’s district!
